name: autoscroll-slider
title: Autoscroll Slider
blurb: Auto-playing carousel slider with variable-width slides and pause on hover.
description: Embla-based carousel with automatic scrolling using the AutoScroll plugin. Supports looping, configurable speed, and pauses on hover or mouse interaction. Renders variable-width slides that scroll horizontally.
use_when: Automatically rotating carousels like testimonials, logos, or featured items without user interaction.
avoid_when: When explicit user control is needed; auto-scroll may distract from content reading.
a11y: Auto-scroll pauses on mouse enter; no keyboard navigation exposed. Focus handling depends on slide content.
